description: Whisper Tiny English, GGML Q5_1 - fast ASR via whisper.cpp on the shared ggml

metadata.notes: GGML format (GGML_FILE_MAGIC), not GGUF - whisper.cpp kept the legacy container while llama.cpp moved to GGUF. audio_ctx is 0 (no encoder truncation) on purpose: truncation is the largest speed lever for live streaming, but too much of it makes the decoder emit repetition loops, and the safe threshold is model-specific. Measured on a Pixel 8: 500 is safe for a 5 s window, 250 degenerates.
